title: Pull, Bull, Pull!
lines: Tim has a bag full of figs.
He pulls it up a tall hill.
A big bull sits on the top.
No. The bull will not go.
So Tim rolls a fig off the hill.
The bull runs and gets it.
Tim pulls the full bag to the top.
"You can have a fig," said Tim.

questions.ask: What is in the bag Tim pulls up the hill?
questions.listenFor: Figs. It is stated in the story - if they cannot find it, have them reread the first line rather than telling them.

questions.ask: Why does Tim roll a fig off the hill?
questions.listenFor: The bull would not move, so Tim got it to run after the fig instead. You want cause and effect, not just "it fell."

questions.ask: Do you think that was a clever plan? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason that comes from the story, like "yes, the bull ran off and Tim got to the top."
